toolParam.ask_question.questions.allowCu: Whether the user may add free-form input (default true)

toolParam.use_skill.name: Skill name or ID (see list_skills)

toolParam.create_memory.projectId: Managed project ID when scope=Project (see list_projects)
toolParam.create_note.title: Note title
toolParam.create_scheduled_task.name: Task name; briefly describe what the task is for

toolParam.create_skill.description: One sentence describing what the skill does

toolParam.create_agent.name: Agent name
toolParam.create_agent.agentType: General (default) | Professional (can bind sub-agents and a model)

toolParam.delete_agent.id: Agent ID (see list_agents; use either this or name)
toolParam.delete_agent.name: Agent name (see list_agents; use either this or id)
toolParam.create_workflow.name: Workflow name

toolParam.update_workflow.name: New name (optional)
toolParam.update_workflow.nodes: New nodes as a JSON array string (optional)
toolParam.update_workflow.edges: New edges as a JSON array string (optional)
toolParam.delete_workflow.id: Workflow ID (see list_workflows; use either this or name)
toolParam.delete_workflow.name: Workflow name (see list_workflows; use either this or id)
toolParam.create_tag.name: Tag name
toolParam.get_usage_stats.days: Number of recent days for the trend (default 7, max 30)

toolParam.plan.title: Plan title (one sentence summarizing what to do)

toolParam.work_read_file.path: File path relative to the project root
toolParam.work_write_file.path: File path relative to the project root
toolParam.work_run_command.cwd: Working directory relative to the project root; defaults to the project root

toolParam.work_grep.glob: Restrict to a filename glob such as **/*.ts, optional
